purpose: Separate post-close reconstruction quality from causal intraday signal eligibility.

A_FULL_RECON_POSTCLOSE: daily OHLCV valid after official close
price repair follows frozen scale -> open/close -> extrema ladder
volume reconciliation only when hourly profile is complete and units are defensible
B_PRICE_RECON_POSTCLOSE: price path can be reconciled but volume or another required intraday field is not defensible
must not silently enable volume-derived features
C_DAILY_RESOLUTION_FALLBACK: never split one daily candle into synthetic AM/PM or 4H bars
RAW_CAUSAL_INTRADAY: feature uses only observations available by its cutoff timestamp
same-day finalized daily high/low/close/volume forbidden before official close
prior completed sessions may be used for persistent calibration if frozen in advance
POSTCLOSE_RECON_ONLY: any repair using current-day finalized daily high/low/close/volume before a hypothetical earlier cutoff receives this tag

notes: Reconstruction consistency is not proof of true intraday path accuracy.
6085 is a known scale/pathology stress case and must not define universal rules.
No strategy returns were used for the tier policy.
